Q. 1 زَحْلَفَهُ , (S, K,) inf. n. زَحْلَفَةٌ, (S,) He rolled him, or it, down or along. (S, K.) ―
-b2- And He pushed, impelled, repelled, or drove away, or back, him, or it. (S, K.) [Hence,] one says, زَحْلَفَ ٱللّٰهُ عَنَّا شَرَّكَ May God put away, or ward off, from us thy mischief. (TA.) ―
-b3- زَحْلَفَ لِفُلَانٍ أَلْفًا He gave to such a one a thousand. (Sgh, K.) ―
-b4- زَحْلَفَ الإِنَآءَ He filled the vessel. (Sgh, K.) ―
-b5- زَحْلَفَ فِى الكَلَامِ He hastened, or was quick, in speech. (Sgh, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
